notes: Voice notes actually transcribe now. The bot discovers the speech-to-text model on your server instead of asking for one it doesn't have, and decodes Telegram's audio format before sending it. The 'not supported' message now names exactly what's missing instead of guessing.
notes_zh: 语音消息现在真正能转成文字了。bot 会自动发现服务器上的语音转写模型，并在发送前先解码 Telegram 的音频格式。“暂不支持”的提示现在会明确说出缺什么，而不是瞎猜。
